correctness.rationale: Re-audited the corrected statement: each reaction residual vanishes and the constant density sum 35/2 corresponds to conserved integral 35π. The conservation row gives an invariant sum-zero hyperplane and zero on its quotient; the remaining cubic is Hurwitz (5·39/2 > 185/2). Every nonconstant Neumann mode has zero integral, so no temporal exponent is to be discarded there. Exact reconstruction from the reactions recovers the published quartic, H2, H3 and mode tables. The discriminant of 2b0(q)/q is −5523716316; its unique real root is negative, so b0(q)>0 for all q>0. At q=1/4 all quartic Hurwitz tests are positive; at q=1 the Routh column is (1,51/2,1745/34,−114114/1745,192), with two sign changes. The positive coefficients exclude positive real roots; the nonzero Hurwitz pivots exclude imaginary-axis roots. Positive coefficients after q=9/4+u prove strict stability for the entire n≥3 tail, not merely tested harmonics. Equal diffusivities would only shift the reaction eigenvalues left. This is a linear result, not a bifurcating-wave or nonlinear-pattern theorem.

evidence: Eq. (27) of Xu et al. supplies J−k²D, and Eq. (28) and its discussion give the sufficient real-root test b0<0. Sections 2.2 and 3.4 do not assert necessity or decide the equal-three-diffusivity case with the corrected witness.

Villar-Sepúlveda–Champneys Theorem 5 and Corollary 1 give broader conditions for wave instability. Remark 4 already gives a different four-field Jacobian with no stationary crossing and wave instability by taking all but one diffusion coefficient zero. Their sign criterion for excluding stationary crossings does not directly apply here: the NPZD phytoplankton diagonal is +5, and the full homogeneous Jacobian is singular by conservation, unlike the strictly stable full Jacobian in their construction.
broader_coverage.reasoning: Generic existence mechanisms and stationary-test-blind four-field examples are prior art. The supplied conditions/example do not imply this strictly positive one-contrast diffusion choice in the conservative NPZD model or its exact Neumann mode count. Substitution into a general characteristic polynomial still requires the continuum sign and infinite discrete checks.

value.rationale: The same-model derivation motivates the determinant diagnostic directly. A strict, exact counterexample to treating it as exhaustive, with only one differing diffusivity and exactly one unstable physical harmonic, distinguishes an oscillatory from a stationary spectral mechanism. Removing the mass normalization error preserves that scientific use. No field calibration or nonlinear pattern inference is warranted.
